name: Kiba Mifuyu
source:
Mifuyu is a second year female student and Yuuki's classmate. She is actually one year older than Yuuki since she had to repeat the same class due to an illness when a junior highschool student. She is Shokken's member. She is also Chisato's best friend.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Koi_to_Senkyo_to_Chocolate]Wikipedia[/url].]
